title: Inference transaction-bound health observation evidence
$comment: Provider transport receives only authenticated snapshot subjects and returns sealed raw observation text. The original caller verifies evidence before running its existing health, GPU, pool, flush and commit phases.

tables.name: aap_inference_health_observation_v1.observation_secret
tables.semantics: One database-local random 32-byte AES256/PGP key; no rotation or per-observation state. Neither dedicated client receives table privileges.

functions.semantics: Secret-free readiness metadata. ready is true only while the singleton 32-byte key exists.

arguments.name: p_backend_json
arguments.description: Exact JSON text for the caller-loaded seven-field Backend snapshot. JSON syntax and the fixed top-level field types are validated, while the original text is encrypted unchanged.

arguments.name: p_timeout_seconds
arguments.description: Any finite value, including zero or negative values, preserving existing transport behavior.

functions.semantics: Binds the exact JSON text, registry/request ids, optional GPU challenge, finite timeout, current database and assigned origin xid. Performs no registry query, row lock, flush or business write. Input is limited to 16 MiB.

returns.description: JSON text with exact fields backend_json, gpu_health_challenge and timeout_seconds. backend_json is returned as a JSON string containing its original bytes after UTF-8 decoding.

functions.semantics: Provider-only open. Requires canonical contiguous base64, authenticated header, exact ids/database, and an originating xid still in progress. Subject size is limited to 24 MiB.

arguments.name: p_observation_json
arguments.description: Raw observation/outcome body text; intentionally not parsed as JSON so NaN/Infinity and legacy decode failures retain their original phase.

functions.semantics: Provider-only seal. Binds the raw body to SHA256(subject), database, origin xid and request/registry ids; validates that the subject's originating transaction remains in progress. Body size is limited to 16 MiB.

returns.description: The original raw observation/outcome body, unchanged.

functions.semantics: Origin-only verify. Requires matching subject digest, ids, database, origin xid, current assigned transaction xid and in-progress status. Committed/aborted, cross-transaction, cross-database, tampered or mismatched evidence fails generically. Evidence size is limited to 24 MiB.
